Scene 1:

“咕噜咕噜”某个⼈肚⼦叫的声⾳把我从⾹甜的睡梦吵醒了！这个⼈如蜗⽜⼀般爬上我住的树⽊。秋季期间，他这个没有礼貌的⼈每天爬上本树，来偷⾛我兄弟姐妹。这个坏⼈好像以为⾃⼰有我们家的所有全！但并不是这样，我树家甚⾄不应该是他的使⽤权。谁宣告整个世界归⼈类所有。我妈妈常常说：“⼈类就是这样，我们地位低的⽔果，虽然是世界上最美丽的梨⼦，但⼈类总是会把我们算是⼩吃⽽已”。看到地上的⼀堆美丽的梨⼦，我不由得想发⽕，他怎么能随便⻢虎得掉我家庭呢？⼀点都不合理，这个肯定不是上帝创造世界的⽬的。
Teacher feedback:
“从香甜的睡梦” incorrect: 从香甜的睡梦中；从 + Place
秋季期间 not very natural: 整个秋季期间；Time + 期间：usually special, long period, “秋季” itself is not “special” enough, “整个/今年秋季” would highlight this particular, special period.
每天爬上：每天都爬上

本树 not very natural: 本+N. is usually used in formal advertisement/news, also it indicates the author owns the tree, which is not the fact: the author is a pear, who does not own the whole pear tree. 爬上这棵树。
我兄弟姐妹：我的兄弟姐妹
所有全：所有权；use the wrong character
我树家甚⾄不应该是他的使⽤权：他甚至不应该有我的“梨树”家的使用权；Subj.有……的使用权，“树家” is a self-created word and vague, better to use “梨树”家，use “” to highlight the metaphor usage of “the pear tree as home”.
我们地位低的⽔果，虽然是世界上最美丽的梨⼦，但⼈类总是会把我们算是⼩吃⽽已：水果是……梨子 is not very precise, 我们地位低的⽔果，虽然是世界上最美丽的；把我们只算作小吃而已：只/不过/才(+num.) + 而已，Subj.算是Obj., “算是”usually is not used in “把”
他怎么能随便⻢虎得掉我家庭呢：马虎地V., use the wrong character；摘掉我的家人：掉itself cannot be followed by an Obj., Subj. 掉 + directional + place, but掉can be resultative complement following another main action verb
这个肯定不是上帝创造世界的⽬的：这肯定不是上帝创造世界的⽬的，delete “个”, 这个 + Noun.
AI feedback:
Grammar Corrections:

1 Incorrect phrase "如蜗⽜⼀般爬上我住的树⽊" / Formula, (⽐较对象) +般 + 动作 / Correct, "他像蜗⽜⼀样爬上我住的树⽊" This correction changes the sentence to a more natural and grammatically correct comparison. Incorrect phrase "这个⼈如蜗⽜⼀般爬上我住的树⽊" / Formula, (主语) + (状语) + (动作) / Correct, "他像蜗⽜⼀样爬上我住的树⽊" This correction changes the subject of the sentence to "他" for clarity and correctness.

My comment: the revision itself is incorrect. 如蜗⽜⼀般 is perfectly right and has more literate flavor, while although the revised “像蜗⽜⼀样” is also correct, it is more colloquial. Changing “这个人” to “他” is not necessary, because the preceding sentence talks about an unspecified “某个人”. It is perfectly fine to use “这个人” as the subject.

2 Incorrect phrase "秋季期间，他这个没有礼貌的⼈每天爬上本树" / Formula, (时间) + (状语) + (动作) / Correct, "秋季期间，他这个没礼貌的⼈每天都爬上这棵树" This correction adds the necessary word "都" to indicate the frequency of the action and changes "本树" to "这棵树" for grammatical correctness.
My comment: the revision of “每天都” and “这棵树” are correct. But it fails to revise “秋季期间”.

3 Incorrect phrase "我树家甚⾄不应该是他的使⽤权" / Formula, (主语) + (动作) + (宾语) / Correct, "我的树屋甚⾄不应该成为他的所有物" This correction changes the phrase to correctly convey the idea that the speaker's treehouse should not belong to the person.

My comment: the revised “…甚⾄不应该成为他的所有物” is correct, but if you want to use 使用权, you need to change it to my revision “他甚至不应该有我的“梨树”家的使用权”. “树屋” is a misunderstanding, because “树屋” refers to “在树上的房子”, not what you really refer to “我的家，也就是这棵树”.
Vocabulary Suggestions
4 Word, "叫" / Context, "咕噜咕噜”某个⼈肚⼦叫的声⾳" / Alternatives, 饿叫 or 咕咕叫, these alternatives are more natural and common ways to describe the sound of a stomach growling.
My comment: "咕噜咕噜” is fine. “饿叫” is incorrect, “咕咕叫” works if it is “某个人肚子咕咕叫的声音”. But your original version is more vivid. I won’t change it.
5 Word, "偷⾛" / Context, "来偷⾛我兄弟姐妹" / Alternatives, 抢⾛ or 携⾛, these alternatives convey a sense of force or suddenness, which may better fit the context of the sentence.
My comment: “抢走” is okay if you want to emphasize “force”, but “偷走” is perfectly fine too. “携走” is incorrect.
6 Word, "使⽤权" / Context, "我树家甚⾄不应该是他的使⽤权" / Alternatives, 所有权 or 占有权, these alternatives more accurately convey the idea of ownership or possession.
My comment: in previous sentence, you already used “所有权”, so here “使用权” is perfectly fine. But the structure is incorrect.
7 Word, "⼩吃" / Context, "虽然是世界上最美丽的梨⼦，但⼈类总是会把我们算是⼩吃⽽已" / Alternatives, 零⻝ or 点⼼, these alternatives are more common and natural ways to describe snacks.
My comment: I agree “零食/点心” is better fit the “downplaying” tone, but “小吃” is fine, too.
8 Word, "地位低" / Context, "我们地位低的⽔果" / Alternatives, 低贱 or 卑微, these alternatives convey a sense of low status or humility, which may better fit the context of the sentence.
My comment: “低贱/卑微” is too strong, and they are less appropriate than “地位低”. No need to change.
Scene 2:

今天的清晨，他⼜来了，先打了⼤哈⽋，然后忙着偷⾛优秀的梨⼦。拼⼏个⼩时之后他就休息了，在地上坐下来，然后突然⼀⼝⽓吃掉了我家⻓！他到底以为⾃⼰是谁啊？难道以为⾃⼰是上帝吗？我⽣⽓极了！下午就继续爬上树，努⼒地找挂满了梨⼦的树⽊。每天就是这样，这个坏⼈好像没有什么有希望的前途，就把希望寄托在梨⼦⾝上。但我没想到他可能很久以前并不是这样，得到了硕⼠和博⼠学位。今天和我朋友⼀起吃⽠的时候，我兄弟说：“他并不⼀直如此精辟⼒尽，整天只能吃梨⼦。他有⼀段时间算是⼈才，有⾼的学历和厉害的主修。但政府实⾏的改⾰经济⼀系列政策就让他失业，被迫转⾏。开始改⾰经济以来，政府不短采取限制⼯作的措施，让每天拿梨⼦的这个⼈没办法回去以前的⼯作。其实挺可怜的。“ 听到这件事，我怎么能还要发⽕呢？但只能思考⼏分钟，就被他拿起来了！我变成了地上的堆梨⼀族。我完全没想到什么事情会⽴刻发⽣。
Teacher feedback:
今天的清晨：今天清晨
先打了⼤哈⽋：先打了个⼤哈⽋
优秀的梨⼦：优质的梨子；“优秀“ cannot be used for items/things, usually for people.
拼⼏个⼩时之后：拼了⼏个⼩时之后；completed
我家⻓：我的爸爸妈妈；“家长“ is used in the context related to “education”, usually referring to parents who deal with children’s education.

下午就继续爬上树：下午他还继续爬上树；miss the Subj., otherwise readers will understand the Subj. here as “我”, which is incorrect. “还“ indicates “surprising, anger” tone, as opposed to “就” with the natural continuation tone.
每天就是这样：每天都是这样
这个坏⼈好像没有什么有希望的前途：没有什么前途；“前途” itself means “hopeful future”, so “有希望” is a little bit redundant.
就把希望寄托在梨⼦⾝上：“寄托在偷梨子上” feels better, “寄托在……身上” usually for people, that is, a specific person carries the hope and can help the Subj. to realize the goal/objective.
但我没想到他可能很久以前并不是这样，得到了硕⼠和博⼠学位：the coherence needs to be improved, 但我没想到的是，他很久以前可能并不是这样碌碌无为，而是拿到了硕⼠和博⼠学位

精辟⼒尽：精疲力尽，use the wrong character. I’m not very sure if “精疲力尽” is the most appropriate word here, since it means “exhausted”, and the pear thief is just busy stealing pears, and I did not see signs of him being “exhausted”.
整天只能吃梨⼦：偷梨子？usually 吃梨子 does not lead to 精疲力尽.
有⾼的学历和厉害的主修：instead of using “有……” structure, it is better to use short sentences: 学历很高，主修专业竞争力也很强。
但政府实⾏的改⾰经济⼀系列政策就让他失业，被迫转⾏：实行的改革经济的一系列政策，却使他失业并被迫转行；“却” indicates unexpected semantic turn, “使” is more formal and better fit other formal words like “失业，被迫，转行”，adding “并” will increase the coherence.
政府不短采取限制⼯作的措施：不断，use the wrong character; 限制就业 is better
没办法回去以前的⼯作：回去做以前的工作

但只能思考⼏分钟，就被他拿起来了：但我只思考了几分钟； the Subj. here cannot be omitted, because the preceding “我怎么能…” is an inserted “narrator comment”, which is temporarily detached from the main storyline. When it goes back to the main story, the Subj. should be restated.
堆梨⼀族：“堆梨” is a self-created word, and it is a bit ambiguous. For me, “堆梨一族” means a group of people who pile pears together, as “堆” here is usually understood as a verb. Perhaps “梨堆的一员”.
我完全没想到什么事情会⽴刻发⽣：这样的事情会发生，as “being picked up” already occurred, so it is not unknown “什么事情”, but a certain “这样的事情”.
AI feedback:
Grammar Corrections:
1 Incorrect phrase "拼⼏个⼩时之后他就休息了" / Formula, (时间/条件) + 后 + (动作)/ Correct, "拼了⼏个⼩时之后他就休息了".
My comment: correct.
2 Incorrect phrase "今天和我朋友⼀起吃⽠的时候" / Formula, 在 + (时间/地点) + (动作) / Correct, "今天我和朋友⼀起吃⽠的时候".
My comment: the original version is fine, no need to change.
3 Incorrect phrase "但我没想到他可能很久以前并不是这样" / Formula, 没想到 + (句⼦) / Correct, "我没想到他以前不是这样".
My comment: the original version is not “incorrect”, but can be more coherent and natural.
4 Incorrect phrase "开始改⾰经济以来，政府不短采取限制⼯作的措施" / Formula, ⾃从 + (时间/事件) + (句⼦) / Correct, "⾃从改⾰经济开始以来，政府采取了很多限制⼯作的措施".
My comment: “开始改⾰经济以来” is correct, no need to change.
Vocabulary Suggestions

5 Word, "坏⼈" / Context, "这个坏⼈好像没有什么有希望的前途" / Alternatives, 这个⼈, 这个家伙, or 不良分⼦ can be used in this context, "坏⼈" is too strong and implies a serious villain, while 这个⼈ or 这个家伙 are more neutral and suitable for describing someone who is simply troublesome or annoying, and 不良分⼦ has a slightly more formal and negative connotation.
My comment: “坏人” is a bit stronger, “这个家伙” is better. “不良分子” is actually a bit awkward.

6 Word, "硕⼠和博⼠学位" / Context, "他得到了硕⼠和博⼠学位" / Alternatives, 研究⽣学位, or ⾼学历 can be used in this context, 硕⼠和博⼠学位 is clear but a bit straightforward, while 研究⽣学位 emphasizes the advanced degree level, and ⾼学历 emphasizes the high level of education.
My comment: “硕士和博士学位” is perfectly fine, no need to change.

7 Word, "精辟⼒尽" / Context, "他并不⼀直如此精辟⼒尽" / Alternatives, ⽆能为⼒, or ⼀⽆是处 can be used in this context, 精辟⼒尽 is not a common phrase in Chinese and may be confusing, while ⽆能为⼒ means unable to do anything, and ⼀⽆是处 means completely useless.
My comment: I agree with “一无是处”, or “碌碌无为”, “无能为力” is not very appropriate here.

8 Word, "地上的堆梨⼀族" / Context, "我变成了地上的堆梨⼀族" / Alternatives, 地上的梨⼦堆, or梨⼦堆⾥ can be used in this context, 地上的堆梨⼀族 is not a common phrase in Chinese and may be confusing, while 地上的梨⼦堆 or梨⼦堆⾥ are more straightforward and clear.
My comment: I agree, my advice is “梨堆的一员”.

9 Word, "思考⼏分钟" / Context, "但只能思考⼏分钟" / Alternatives, 想了⼏分钟, or 思考了⼀会⼉ can be used in this context, 思考⼏分钟 is a bit formal and literal, while 想了⼏分钟 is more casual and conversational, and 思考了⼀会⼉ emphasizes the short duration of the thought process.
My comment: I agree with “了”, but AI feedback missed other places that should be revised.
Scene 3:

突然我们⼀堆梨⼦被某个⼩孩⼉拿起来。我以前以为⼈类的问题是⼈们不尊重世界上⾃然的规定，圣经据说的法律。但⼈类连⼈类划定的规定也不尊重！虽然我认为⾃⼰的树⽊不是任何⼈的所有权，据⼈类法律规定，我是那个以前说的坏⼈的所有权，但这个⼩孩⼉完全不在乎不尊重。我⽆话可说！⼈类创造⽂明到底从哪⾥由此⽽来啊，看起⼀点⽂明都没有。不过，下个发⽣的事情还更奇怪。骑⾃⾏⻋逃跑的时候，他突然看到了某个⼥孩⼉，这奇怪的男孩⼀看到她，就头昏脑胀，紧接着撞到⽯头摔倒了。我们梨堆⼀族都乱地滚来滚去地上。正好三个男孩⾛过了刚才摔倒的男孩。看到我们糟糕的状态，⽤⼼得来帮忙整理梨⼦，拿起骑⻋。那个摔倒的男孩⼉很感谢他们，就送了⼏个梨⼦。但那些三个男孩不知不觉和梨⼦⾛过了被偷⾛的有梨⼦所有权的第⼀个⼈。⼈类就多么奇怪呢。
Teacher feedback:
世界上⾃然的规定，圣经据说的法律：自然规律 as a fixed expression；圣经所依据的法律：“据说”can only be used at sentence initial, separate from other parts, followed by the information that is heard.
但⼈类连⼈类划定的规定也不尊重：连自己制定的规定，do not repeat “人类” twice, 制定规定 as a fixed expression.
虽然我认为⾃⼰的树⽊不是任何⼈的所有权：不归任何人所有/任何人都没有我的树木的所有权
据⼈类法律规定，我是那个以前说的坏⼈的所有权：但据⼈类法律规定，我归之前说的那个坏人所有
但这个⼩孩⼉完全不在乎不尊重：可，because earlier “但“ is already used, here use “可” as alternative.
⼈类创造⽂明到底从哪⾥由此⽽来啊：人类创造的文明，the Subj. should be a noun “文明”, not a verb phrase “人类创造文明”；到底从何而来：由此而来 means “come from this”, but here should be a question “come from where”.
看起⼀点⽂明都没有：看起来一点儿都不文明，“文明” can be an Adj., meaning “civilized”.
下个发⽣的事情：下面发生的事情

骑⾃⾏⻋逃跑的时候，他突然看到了某个⼥孩⼉：replace “他” with “这个小男孩”，otherwise “他” is ambiguous, who? 一个女孩儿，“某个” refers to a specific person/thing, only not identifying the name. Here he saw “one girl”, not “a specific girl”.
这奇怪的男孩⼀看到她：这个奇怪的男孩，这/那 + Measure word + noun.
我们梨堆⼀族都乱地滚来滚去地上：我们这堆梨都在地上乱糟糟/乱七八糟地滚来滚去，在place滚来滚去，multi-syllabic adv. + 地（mono-syllabic adv. cannot be used with 地）

看到我们糟糕的状态，⽤⼼得来帮忙整理梨⼦，拿起骑⻋：他们过来用心地帮忙整理梨子，扶起自行车，since the preceding phrase has “我们”, the Subj. 他们 should be stated, adv.地V，“骑车” is a verb phrase, cannot be the Obj. of “扶起”，“拿起” is usually used for smaller items.

但那些三个男孩不知不觉和梨⼦⾛过了被偷⾛的有梨⼦所有权的第⼀个⼈：那三个男孩/那些男孩，“些” cannot be used with num.; 拿着梨子，“和+noun.” is used for multiple nouns that have the same action, we can say: 那三个男孩和拿走梨子的小男孩走过了……，because both 三个男孩 and 小男孩 “walk past…”, but here “梨子” do not walk, so you need to use the accompanying phrase “V.着”; “被偷⾛的有梨⼦所有权的第⼀个⼈” is too long, 第一个被偷走梨子的人 is clear enough.
⼈类就多么奇怪呢：人类就是这么奇怪呢/人类多么奇怪啊
AI feedback:
Grammar Corrections:
1 Incorrect phrase "⼈类的问题是⼈们不尊重世界上⾃然的规定" / Formula, ⼈类的问题在于 + (问题描述) / Correct, "⼈类的问题在于⼈们不尊重世界上的⾃然规定" This correction changes the sentence structure to better fit the intended meaning.
My comment: I agree “在于” is better than “是”, but “是” itself is not “incorrect”.

2 Incorrect phrase "虽然我认为⾃⼰的树⽊不是任何⼈的所有权" / Formula, 虽然 + (个⼈观点)，但是 + (客观事实) / Correct, "虽然我认为⾃⼰的树⽊不应该属于任何⼈，但是按照⼈类法律，我是那个树⽊的所有权" This correction adds a contrast to show the difference between the personal opinion and the objective fact.

My comment: the earlier part of the revised version is correct, but “我是那个树⽊的所有权” is incorrect, it should be “我有那棵树的所有权”, which is grammatically correct, but semantically incorrect. “我“ as a pear, does not own the tree, but is part of the tree.

3 Incorrect phrase "我们梨堆⼀族都乱地滚来滚去地上" / Formula, (主语) + (状语) + (动作) + (在/到) + (地⽅) / Correct, "我们的⼀堆梨⼦都滚来滚去地散落在地上" This correction changes the phrase to make it grammatically correct and more descriptive.
My comment: the revised version is also correct, but my revision (see above “teacher feedback”) is better aligned with what you wanted to express.
Vocabulary Suggestions

4 Word, "规定" / Context, "⾃然的规定" / Alternatives, 规律 or 法则 could be better options as they convey a sense of natural or universal laws, whereas 规定 often refers to man-made rules. The original word has a more rigid, rule-oriented connotation, while the alternatives imply a more inherent or fundamental principle.
My comment: correct.

5 Word, "划定的规定" / Context, "⼈类划定的规定" / Alternatives, 制定的规则 or 确⽴的法律 would be more suitable, as they describe the process of creating or establishing laws or rules. This change can help to clarify the concept of human-made laws and regulations.
My comment: correct.

6 Word, "所有权" / Context, "我是那个以前说的坏⼈的所有权" / Alternatives, 拥有者or 物主 could be used instead to convey the idea of ownership more naturally. The original phrase sounds somewhat formal or official, whereas the alternatives provide a more common way to express ownership.
My comment: I agree with the explanation of the word “拥有者/物主”.

7 Word, "乱地" / Context, "我们梨堆⼀族都乱地滚来滚去地上" / Alternatives, 乱七⼋糟 or 到处滚 could be used to describe the chaotic scene in a more vivid and engaging way. The original word is quite general, while the alternatives offer more descriptive and dynamic language.
My comment: the revised version is correct, but AI did not explain why the original version is incorrect: mono-syllabic adverb cannot be used with 地 + verb. It must be a multi-syllabic adverb.

8 Word, "糟糕的状态" / Context, "看到我们糟糕的状态" / Alternatives, 乱糟糟的样⼦ or狼狈不堪的样⼦ could better convey the image of disorder and chaos. The original phrase is somewhat generic, whereas the alternatives provide more evocative and descriptive options.

My comment: the revised version is correct, but AI did not explain why “糟糕的状态” is not very appropriate here. “状态” is generally used for people, related to mental state. But since you used metaphor to liken pears to people, it is acceptable to use “状态” here.
